connector.name: Easy8
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to Easy8 - read and update projects, issues, and comments.
connector.summary: Hosted at {easy8_host} over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the easy8com account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Redmine-API-Key
headers.description: Your personal Easy8 API key, generated from your Easy8 user profile. The MCP endpoint inherits this account's permissions and project visibility.
